excerpt: Nucl.Phys.A757:102-183,2005. "[C]entral Au+Au collisions at RHIC produce dense, rapidly thermalizing matter characterized by ... nearly ideal fluid flow", but "the measurements themselves do not yet establish unequivocal evidence for a transition to this new form of matter."
title: Experimental and Theoretical Challenges in the Search for the Quark Gluon Plasma: The STAR Collaboration's Critical Assessment of the Evidence from RHIC Collisions
